Let's solve this step by step:

1) First, let's note the given information:
   • The 1st Sunday of the month is on the 2nd
   • The 3rd Sunday of the month is on the 16th

2) Since the first Sunday is on the 2nd, the 2nd Sunday would be on the 9th

3) And since the 3rd Sunday is on the 16th, the 4th Sunday would be on the 23rd

4) In the original information, we know the 1st Sunday falls on the 2nd, so if we look at what day the 2nd is:
   • The first Sunday is on the 2nd
   • This means the first Sunday is the 2nd of the month

5) If the 1st Sunday is on the 2nd, we know the 4th Sunday (which is the 23rd) will be the same day of the week

6) This is because each Sunday in a month is exactly 7 days apart

Therefore, the 23rd will be a Sunday.

The answer is Sunday.
